scope: Read-only review of exact V3 static contract, pinned source/worktree identity, H230 family-target/cache/trainer semantics, fold membership and stated profile/fit/export stages. No cache, profile, fit or score was run.
verified_source_recipe_findings: The V3 contract corrects the V2 output-width defect. Pinned trainer derives 2 main + 19 structural (12 spread, 3 branch, 4 class) + 2 next-change + 8 family outputs =31. The empty default aux-next-k gives no additional horizons. Indices are main 0-1, structural 2-20, next-change 21-22 and family 23-30.

Both own GRU256x2 C1 seed-matched initializers use aux_struct=.3 and aux_next=.3 with no next-change horizons, so their checkpoint readouts have 23 rows; pinned family-head extension appends exactly eight rows and copies those 23. The declared 31-row model is compatible with the warm starts.

Cache source coefficients .15,.15,.10,.10,.125,.125,.03125,.03125 sum to .8125. The source variant is the unnormalized weighted sum; normalized and homogeneous variants are separate controls. Family targets are equal per-family means in strong/full_finetuned/raw_wmse/samefold_baseline order, with raw targets, weight .1, and the unchanged main label-derived weights. Main labels and source-sum teacher blend are clipped to ±2; official global_wp_clip2_v1 is unchanged.

The cached trainer dataset has original labels plus 2 main-cache channels plus 8 family channels (12 target columns); the source trainer checks this exact width. Family loss averages four two-target family WMSEs, weighted from clipped original labels. The family-head rows do not change exported predictions: predict_run returns the first two channels.

Pinned fold loader returned split SHA 09263ad4fe2b18e2b2f3b79f4562678dce801b067b868134ddc79279f9316a3d and exact groups 10,535 train fit, 1,405 valid fit and 468 excluded evaluation. Current train target index is 10,606 unique groups; valid index is 1,873 and equals the 1,405+468 valid partition. The full source rows are exported/available, while builder filtering and manifest membership gates are required before cache rows are admitted.

Builder output estimate 11,940 fit groups × 20,000 rows × 4 bytes ×14 channels =13,372,800,000 bytes; its 25-GiB free floor and 30-GiB output budget use powers of 2 despite --*-gb argument names. The exact builder floor plus estimate is 40,216,345,600 free bytes.

Profile is profile-only, one attempt, B16/chunk2000/full auxiliary+family path, 3 warmup and20 measured steps, one GPU lock, 3 CPU/6.5-GB worker, 4.3-GB allocator and5-GB observed-VRAM gate. Fit stays serial for seeds3/4, 2 epochs fixed zero-based epoch1 with no fit evaluation, 5.4k-second cap per seed; allocation requires the actual profile to project two epochs plus checkpoint save within cap and preserve resource headroom.

Prediction contract exports fixed epoch1 to the 1,873-row valid target index and 2 columns; grading still uses the frozen 468-row excluded fold0 mask. This is an exposed development comparison against E511 C1, not an isolated family-head effect or public forecast.
